Three real live queues from the AIDev dataset (Li et al., https://huggingface.co/datasets/hao-li/AIDev, CC BY 4.0),
exported by `experiments/bench_v2/export_e2e_fixtures.py`: one cross-author duplicate, one self-replacement, and one
PR with no duplicate. Diffs are stored as file lists, changed-line ranges and hashes of added lines, not as code.
